name: Hiwatari Rintarou
source:
A bright, energetic and frank person.
He may seem sloppy but he unexpectedly likes to keep things tidy.
He's been tall since middle school so he's the ace and captain of the volleyball club.
The protagonist's underclassman, but they don't really know each other directly.
